title: SMART Guidelines KG L2-BPMN classes
description: The classes a L2-BPMN knowledge-graph node can be. smart-base document kinds and extractions name them as `sgkg-l2-bpmn#<code>`. GENERATED by smart-base/L1/schemas/emit.ts from smart-base/L2-bpmn/schemas/l2-bpmn.ts: do not hand-edit; change the layer source and run `npm run build` in smart-base/L1/schemas/.

source.note: smart-base/L2-bpmn/schemas/l2-bpmn.ts, the layer's `classes`: id, name, note and iri.

codes.label: BPMN File
codes.definition: One BPMN file as a unit -- the `bpmn:definitions` root. Shares its IRI with the l1:external-artifact for the same file, so the component that points at it and the subgraph that opens it name one resource.

codes.label: BPMN Process
codes.definition: One `bpmn:process`. Present as a node because a participant references it by processRef, and without it the pool-to-element attribution has nothing to travel through.

codes.label: BPMN Participant
codes.definition: A pool: a role that owns part of the collaboration. The lifecycle BPMN has 8 and declares no laneSet at all, so the pool is the only unit of role assignment present and its @name is the sole link to a persona.

codes.label: BPMN Task
codes.definition: A task or sub-process. It is what a DMN usingTask href points at, what sequence flows connect, and what a DAK-level task entry describes. Sub-processes carry isSubProcess rather than getting a class of their own -- the lifecycle BPMN has exactly one.

codes.label: BPMN Gateway
codes.definition: A branch or merge. Included for connectivity rather than for a cross-model edge: a flow through a gateway with no node would point at nothing, and every reachability question over the process would break at the first decision point.

codes.label: BPMN Event
codes.definition: A start or end event. Same connectivity argument as gateway, plus one of its own: entry and exit points are what make 'is this task reachable' and 'does this path terminate' answerable at all.
